notes.title: MEOW! ≽^•⩊•^≼
notes.content:
Hey there!
We’re excited to announce that the game has just left Early Access!
That means it’s now available in its full, polished version!

What’s new?
A few awesome new cats have joined the roster — don’t be fooled by their cute appearance… they’re deadly dangerous!
Several new locations have popped up on the world map — two in Australia and one right in the middle of the ocean!
You can now find a really cool book in the attic, filled with fun facts about all the animals.
In the lab, you can craft brand-new, extraordinary potions. (Come on — who hasn’t dreamed of a cat that shoots lasers from its eyes?)

We hope the full release inspires even more of you to share your thoughts and feedback — together we can keep making the game even better!
And don’t forget to leave a review on Steam — it means a lot to us! ❤️

Hania & Sebastian

notes.title: Awesome update 2
notes.content: [p]Dear Cat Lovers![/p][p]Patch 0.9.4 is out, bringing you:[/p][list][*][p] Australia – unlockable after America – two brand-new maps full of kangaroos, spiders, and bats![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A new cat – a tricolor feline with a truly powerful special ability![/p][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160354/33faef56b0cdd6c20dcecb4313df3942d8c39a87.gif"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, we’ve slightly adjusted our plans: the full version of the game will now launch with the next update.[/p][p]We’re counting on your feedback.[/p][p]Have fun and enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Awesome update 1
notes.content:
Attention all feline units!
Patch 0.9.3 has just landed—like a cat on its feet—and it brings:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160354/7420c63cd3acf8493214ad03dcc32e6d26d9c509.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]The Underwater Map – unlocks right after Asia! Dive into the depths, battle crabs, sharks, and jellyfish (yes, they’re grumpy), and claim a reward that’ll knock the whiskers off your face!
[*]Rage Potion – your cat gets so mad it can take down enemies with a single glare. Side effects may include fury, eye sparks, and total chaos.
[*]Wealth Potion – with this baby, prices won’t scare you anymore. A rich cat is a happy cat.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160354/454f0c4748112973202d0ddee72996402a90687b.gif[/img]

Happy meowing and good luck out there!

notes.title: Early Access & What’s Next
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to let you know that the game is now available in Early Access!
It’s been an amazing journey getting to this point, and we’re super excited to finally share it with you.

But this is just the beginning. Early Access means we’re building this game together — with your feedback, ideas, and love for all things feline.
We have lots of exciting plans for future updates, including new features, improvements, and surprises that we can’t wait to show you.

Take a look at what’s coming next on our roadmap below — and don’t be shy! Join the conversation, share your thoughts, and help us make this the best cat-themed game it can possibly be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160354/b554bb9aaedff58d35d7a031b7309aa14c1d3d6c.png[/img]

Thanks for being part of this adventure.

Enjoy the game and give your cats a high-five from us!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1][b]"Laser Battle Cats" is coming—with a meow loud enough to shake continents.[/b][/h1]

Collect cats, feed them suspicious milk, and gear them up with laser-powered contraptions. Set out on missions full of shooting, battery charging, and physics-based puzzles. Take down pigeons in Europe and snakes in Africa. Each cat has unique stats—find your favorites and train them for battle.

Between missions, upgrade your base: grow herbs, improve your workshop, and brew powerful mixtures for your fluffy warriors.

[b]April 18, 2025 – wishlist now and prepare for feline domination[/b]
